Zero Trace is the design goal of minimizing app-controlled traces and persistent session data: no browser storage, cookies, or app caches are used, and controlled sensitive buffers are overwritten. The browser, operating system, swap space, crash dumps, extensions, and clipboard may still retain copies. Downloads occur only on explicit user action.
